payload.name: Search concrete project names for category questions
payload.description: When a question asks what kind(s) or type(s) of projects, items, or work someone has done, search using concrete object/domain terms and enumerate distinct named projects before answering.
content: When a question asks what kind(s) or type(s) of projects, items, or work a person has done, treat one generic query as insufficient; it can return vague 'project' memories instead of concrete named projects.

Run at least one additional hybrid or keyword search using concrete object nouns or domain-specific project terms (not only the generic category label), with memory_kinds ['event','plan'] before answering.
Enumerate distinct named projects from all retrieved event/plan memories; include a specific named project even if its memory was not the top-ranked hit.

solves: A category question such as 'what kind of engineering projects has this person worked on?' often receives one generic search, so vague 'project' memories crowd out concrete named projects. The failure is a retrieval rule gap: category-enumeration questions need object-level searches and enumeration of distinct named memories. The rule applies to any question asking kinds/types of projects, creative work, or owned items, but not to questions about a single project or a numeric count.
